title: Dark and bright green dots change..
symptom: After changing transmitters, the dark and bright green dots in the graphs change status/color often, even when the phone is near the G6 and xDrip is receiving BGs regularly.
cause: The issue is related to the recalculated data code when there is a slide of the 5 min delays when G6 transmitters are changed. The problem stops 36 hours after transmitter change.
fix: The issue was resolved in issue #3413, but the specific fix is not described in this thread.
evidence_quote: Stopping smoothing in AAPS does NOT stop the dot problem..The end of 36 hours after transmitter change stops the problem. So, the "culprit" is with/around the recalculated data code (when there is a "slide" of the 5 min delays when the G6 transmitters are changes).
